title: Kolibri 1 Q4_K_M GGUF on llama.cpp (bartowski)
slug_note: Aleph Alpha's 78B MoE (3.46B active) as a 49.8 GB GGUF; one llama-server command.

variation.quant_detail: Q4_K_M, 49.76 GB (per-tensor layout; needs llama.cpp b11716 or newer)
variation.revision_note: HF snapshot of bartowski/Kolibri-1-GGUF resolved and served on the Spark during the 2026-10-27 test

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-10-27): 53.3 GiB dropped from MemAvailable with the recipe as written (llama-server build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772) at the build default context (4 slots x 8192 tokens)). Earlier estimate: Estimate: the 49.8 GB file plus KV cache at a modest context. Not measured.

steps.text: Install llama.cpp b11716 or newer (see Step 0 in Quick start).

drop in MemAvailable from before start (OS file cache dropped) to server ready; llama-server build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772) at the build default context (4 slots x 8192 tokens)

caveats: Aleph Alpha's official weights are FP8 (~78 GB) for data-centre GPUs; this is bartowski's community GGUF.
The card recommends 262K context or less for serving; 1M is by extrapolation.

Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-27): `llama-server -hf bartowski/Kolibri-1-GGUF:Q4_K_M` — llama.cpp build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772); server ready 50 s after start with the OS file cache dropped; the functional check passed; MemAvailable dropped 53.3 GiB (weights + KV at llama.cpp's default context (4 slots x 8192 tokens on this build)).
